programme.title: Inside My Borders
programme.desc: Summer 2020. The terrible Covid pandemic that has shaken the world and has also influenced the way many people travel, limiting the possibilities of going abroad and discovering new destinations. But this was not a problem for Michele Sanna, who took the opportunity to go and visit places in Italy that he had not yet seen but planned for a long time.

programme.title: The Words of Wine / Le Parole del Vino
programme.desc: The Words of Wine - Azienda Agraria Fiorini. Nestled in the picturesque hills of Marche, the Fiorini farm has thrived for over a century, passed down through three generations. Founded in 1900 by agronomist Luigi Fiorini, the estate began with a vision and a vineyard. Guided by Luigi's passion, his son Valentino and wife Silvana expanded the legacy, creating a warm haven for wine enthusiasts.

programme.title: The Words of Wine: Alberto Quacquarini
programme.desc: Serrapetrona is a small town in the hills of central Italy, where time seems to stand still. Harsh winters and Mediterranean summers have shaped a landscape where nature and tradition exist in perfect harmony. It is here that Vernaccia di Serrapetrona DOCG, a rare and prestigious sparkling red wine, has its roots.This documentary tells the story of the Alberto Quacquarini winery, the leading producer of Vernaccia di Serrapetrona DOCG.

programme.title: Date with Nature Season 4 Episode 10
programme.desc: Date with Nature is a serene, anti-stress TV series designed to calm the mind and inspire a sense of balance and peace. Season Four, The Music of Nature, features 10 breathtaking new episodes, showcasing stunning landscapes and immersive natural stories captured by the teams at Living Nature HD and HOME 4K.

programme.title: The Raftmakers
programme.desc: Building rafts with nature's gifts, with occasional travel companions and venturing on adventurous explorations of rivers that cross tropical forests, urban centres, and landfills. All of this is The Raftmakers. There are limited resources, innumerable difficulties and dangers with adopting the pioneering approach of the past. Everything is filmed and narrated by documentary maker Igor D'India.

programme.title: Dust
programme.desc: DUST it is a motorsport project outside of the races, with riders and drivers training, testing or just having fun with their machines. From two wheels sports like Trial, Enduro, Rally Raid, Motocross, Sidecar to four wheels Rally, WRC, Group B legends and Rally Raid.

programme.title: Unsustainable / Insostenibile
programme.desc: Two friends begin a traverse in one of the wildest environments of the Italian Dolomites along the Alta Via delle Dolomiti Bellunesi. Is sustainable tourism possible in the last wild corner of the Dolomites? With this question in mind two friends set off on a walking adventure along the Alta Via delle Dolomiti Bellunesi, from the home of Santi Padros, a mountain guide and a Spaniard who moved to Val di Zoldo, to the home of Diego Toigo, instructor of CAI Feltre.

programme.title: Mountain Bike in Valle D'Aosta Episode 5
programme.desc: The mountain bike is one of the most interesting way of transport for discovering the Alpine territory. In fact, it allows you to move quickly on trails and farm roads, covering distances in a short time. The ebike has further extended this possibility and in this series of episodes Ettore Personnettaz will take you on a journey to discover places, territories, curiosities and above all people and friends who, like him, live in the splendid mountains of the Aosta Valley.

programme.title: Kyrgyzstan Where Are You?
programme.desc: Kyrgyzstan, Where Are You? - Cycling in the Kingdom of the Eagles. Join a journey through the rugged landscapes of Kyrgyzstan, a cyclist's paradise nestled in Central Asia. Starting near Bishkek and pedal through the stunning Songkol Lake at 3,300 meters, surrounded by nomadic yurts and herds roaming the plains. Continue to Ysykkol, the second-largest mountain lake globally, exploring surreal rock formations like Mars Canyon and the Fairy Tale Canyon along the way.

programme.title: Seize the Day
programme.desc: Seize the Day features some of the best surfers in the world surfing epic waves in California and Hawaii. With a fun soundtrack and friendly vibe Seize The Day will stoke any surfer. Some of the surfers include Kelly Slater, John John Florence, Griffin Colapinto, Nat Young and many more.

programme.title: Zero to Level
programme.desc: Zero to Level documents Aldo Mazzocchi's awe-inspiring journey from sea level to the summit of Kilimanjaro. This motor-free odyssey encompasses soft kayaking, mountain biking, mountaineering, and paragliding, traversing the four elements-water, earth, fire, and air. Accompanied by photographer Ottavio Tomasini, Aldo follows the reverse water cycle from the Indian Ocean to Kilimanjaro's peak. Paddling 190 km, biking 500 km, and ascending Kibo on foot, he conquers each challenge.

programme.title: California Skies
programme.desc: (Also available with narration) California Skies is an experiential video that combines beautiful original music by award winning composer Alan Williams with 4K video images by multiple Emmy Award winner veteran cinematographer Howard Hall. California's turbulent atmosphere is revealed with time lapse photography as mountain, desert, and coastal landscapes are explored by ultralight aircraft.

programme.title: BMX Street
programme.desc: From the creators of Youtube Channel phenomena "woozyBMX" which has over 60 million views on Youtube alone, 'BMX STREET' documents some of the best BMX Street Riders in Events & Jams. 'BMX STREET' showcases the fun and good times and also shows the struggle of pulling a trick which may involve a crash or two! Riders include: Bruno Hoffmann, Simone Barraco, Felix Prangenberg, Nico van Loon, Mike Curley, Mark Burnett, Joris Coulomb, Moritz Nussbaumer and many more!

programme.title: I Stay Home / Io Resto a Casa
programme.desc: The term "quarantine" comes from the 40 days of isolation to which ships returning from areas affected by the plague in the 14th century were subjected. On 30 January 2020, the WHO recommended 14 days of quarantine were necessary to contain the spread of the new Coronavirus. On the morning of 10 March 2020 all Italians woke up in quarantine. In "I stay home", I depict the first 14 days of the Italian lockdown without ever leaving my house.

programme.title: BMX Street

Riders include: Bruno Hoffmann, Simone Barraco, Felix Prangenberg, Nico van Loon, Mike Curley, Mark Burnett, Joris Coulomb, Moritz Nussbaumer and many more!

programme.title: Never Give Up
programme.desc: Laura Rogora is a special person: the strongest female climber in the world ever and she's only 19. But Laura is one of those girls who has amazed us so much and in such a short period of time that we can't even imagine what she is capable to do. Today she is on her way to the Olympics in Tokio 2021. Official Selection 2022: In The Palace International Short Film Festival.

programme.title: Dhaulagiri 2021
programme.desc: Dhaulagiri 2021 - The 7th Summit. In 2021, Marco Camandona and Pietro Picco, alpinists and alpine guides from the Aosta Valley in Italy, set off with an ambitious objective: to climb Dhaulagiri (8167m), the world's 7th tallest mountain in the purest of forms: without additional oxygen or external support. This adventure takes them to Kathmandu, then Pokhara and finally at the heart of the Himalaya, in between the world's tallest mountains.

programme.title: Wild Atlantic Way
programme.desc: The Wild Atlantic Way, the world's longest coastal route, stretches 2,000 kilometers from the fishing village of Kinsale in County Cork to Derry in Northern Ireland. Renowned for its dramatic cliffs, picturesque villages, and breathtaking views, this iconic road offers more than just scenery, it's a journey deeply connected to the untamed beauty of nature. In September 2023, Pietro embarked on an extraordinary adventure, cycling the entire route using only his own strength.

programme.title: Awesome Longboard Bros
programme.desc: This feel-good film captures the true spirit of longboarding, reminding us all that sometimes, the best waves are the ones you catch with your friends. With Oliver Parker and Daniel Graham.

programme.title: Food Rebels / I Ribelli del Cibo
programme.desc: Through four stories, Food Rebels tells the life of small food producers, their enthusiasm and their difficulties, between minimum every day targets (in short, economical survival) and a very high ambition: changing the world of food, dominated by large retailers and low quality food. The microcosm of South Tyrol, a land where tradition and innovation go hand in hand and where you can find a particularly fertile humus, is the background of universal and urgent matters.

programme.title: White Wedding
programme.desc: In JACKSON HOLE, WYOMING, the relentless winter of 2017 was one for the record books. Relive this epic 600 inch season in Storm Show's newest ski/ride/adrenaline film WHITE WEDDING. Highlights include: NECK DEEP POWDER, MASSIVE AIRS & PROBABLE FIRST DESCENTS, the show-stopping SNOWPOCALYPSE event, and a 40 MILE EXPEDITION into the heart of the WIND RIVER RANGE.

programme.title: Marrakech
programme.desc: Marrakech - Dakar, Gravelling Solo. In November 2023, adventurer Nico Valsesia invites friends and followers on a once-in-a-lifetime journey: cycling from Marrakech to Dakar in 21 days. This non-competitive, 2700 km trek across Morocco, Mauritania and Senegal promises unforgettable experiences. With a spirit of adaptation and minimal support, 13 adventurers set off on January 7, 2024.

programme.title: I Stay Home / Io Resto a Casa
programme.desc: The term "quarantine" comes from the 40 days of isolation to which ships returning from areas affected by the plague in the 14th century were subjected. On 30 January 2020, the WHO recommended 14 days of quarantine were necessary to contain the spread of the new Coronavirus. On the morning of 10 March 2020 all Italians woke up in quarantine. In "I stay home", I depict the first 14 days of the Italian lockdown without ever leaving my house.

programme.title: Le Passage / Il Passaggio
programme.desc: Those who live on the borders of the Alpes know it well: mountains are a place of passage, to be crossed or surmounted, constantly moving across passes. "Le Passage" portrays the history and daily life of two valleys between Italy and Switzerland. Semi Finalist - Montreal Independent Film Festival 2020. Official Selection 2017: Cervino Cinemountain.

programme.title: La Fuga Episode 3
programme.desc: La Fuga follows the uproarious adventures of the dynamic comic duo PanPers as they embark on a bike training journey in eastern Liguria. Little do they know that their coach, Alessandro Gambino, has planned hilarious challenges, including pedaling on a boat to Portofino while indulging in tempting delicacies. The journey takes unexpected turns, from climbs and descents to time-traveling escapades in Santo Stefano al Mare.

programme.title: Walking in Iceland
programme.desc: Walking in Iceland is a solo walking trip in Iceland. Visit the Breiðamerkurjökull glacier, a surreal and incredible place with its canyons and ice caves. Unfortunately, global warming is having devastating effects on Icelandic glaciers and beyond. Walk with me to see the changes this glacier has had in just 6 months. Unfortunately, many parts of both the Ice Canyon and the Ice Cave filmed in this documentary no longer exist.

programme.title: Guest List
programme.desc: Tom Wallisch and the Good Company crew return with their second full-length film, Guest List, featuring world class urban, park and backcountry skiing, all with their trademark fun style. Travel the world with Good Company as they seek out new cities, fresh pow and never been done tricks. The Guest List for this party is stacked and just getting started!

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA is in Hammond, Indiana with the Featherweight World Title on the line as Champ Daniel Straus and former Champ Pat Curran meet for a third time to decide who walks away with the title.

programme.title: Bellator 123: Curran vs Pitbull 2
programme.desc: Bellator MMA heads to Mohegan Sun as Pat Curran looks to defend his featherweight belt against bitter rival Patricio Pitbull. Also on the card, WWE superstar Bobby Lashley returns to the cage, along with knockout artists Cheick Kongo and King Mo.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Plymouth, Missouri with the Light Heavyweight World Title on the line as Champ Emanuel Newton takes on journeyman Joey Beltran.

programme.title: Bellator 125: Manhoef vs Marshall
programme.desc: Bellator MMA heads to Fresno, California with a showdown between middleweight knockout artists Doug Marshall and Melvin Manhoef. Also in action is submission ace Goiti Yamauchi, Javy Ayala, and Rafael Carvalho.

programme.title: Bellator 131: Ortiz vs. Bonnar
programme.desc: The talking is over. Bonnar. Ortiz. Time to fight.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA heads to Thackerville, Oklahoma with the Bantamweight title on the line as Joe Warren defends his strap against Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu World Champion Marcos Galvao. And Ryan Couture faces off against Dakota Cochrane in a lightweight clash.

programme.title: Bellator 138: Kimbo vs Shamrock
programme.desc: Bellator MMA presents a grudge match seven years in the making as Kimbo Slice finally meets Ken Shamrock. Patricio Pitbull goes to war with Daniel Weichel for the featherweight title. Plus WWE superstar Bobby Lashley and Michael Chandler return to action.

programme.title: Bellator 144: Halsey vs Carvalho
programme.desc: The middleweight title is on the line as Bellator MMA returns to Mohegan Sun with Rafael Carvalho vs. Brandon Halsey. And walking highlight reel Michael “MVP” Page is in action, along with submission specialist Goiti Yamauchi.

programme.title: Bellator 148: Daley vs Uhrich
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Fresno, California as feared knockout artist Paul Daley looks to make a highlight reel out of Andy Uhrich, while heavy-handed Patricky Pitbull aims to add another KO to his record when he takes on the son of an icon, Ryan Couture.

programme.title: Bellator 153: Koreshkov vs Henderson
programme.desc: Benson Henderson makes his Bellator debut against Champion Andrey Koreshkov.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to San Jose, California with a highly anticipated matchup be-tween King Mo and Phil Mr. Wonderful Davis. Also, hard-hitting lightweight Saad “The Assassin” Awad and submission ace Adam Piccolotti aim to impress.

programme.title: Bellator 158: Lima v Daley
programme.desc: Bellator MMA invades England as Paul Daley and Douglas Lima meet in a long-awaited showdown between welterweight knockout artists. And don’t miss Michael “MVP” Page as he looks to go viral against Cyborg Santos. Plus Matt Mitrione and James Gallagher!

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA invades Memphis as former middleweight champion Alexander Shlemenko takes on Kendall “Da Spyda” Grove. And WWE superstar Bobby Lashley looks to continue his winning ways against Josh Appelt in a battle of hard-hitting heavyweights.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA goes global as it emanates from Tel Aviv, Israel for a highly anticipated rematch between Andrey Koreshkov and Douglas Lima for the welterweight title in whats sure to be an action-packed main-event between two of the best in the world.

programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: MLB Central

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E02 - India Part 2
programme.desc: Gordon’s got a taste for adventure and heads off the tourist track into impenetrable north-east India, home of the country’s best-kept culinary secrets. Leaving the 21st century behind, he immerses himself in the life of a local meat-loving tribe in Nagaland, once better known for head-hunting than their curries. Then he’s off to Assam to enter a housewives’ competition to find the best Assamese dish; and finally he sets up shop among the street food stalls of Calcutta to try and tempt the local foodies into buying north-east curry – Ramsay style.

programme.title: El que avisa no es traidor
programme.desc: Programa de humor donde se desarrollan diversos sketches con temas de actualidad o situaciones cotidianas.

programme.title: Cada loco con su tema
programme.desc: Conocemos a una mujer que seguro se convierte en la estrella de la temporada: La Vieja'l Visillo. Ella consigue hacer correr como la pólvora todos los cotilleos que ha logrado averiguar.

programme.title: La ocasión la pintan calva
programme.desc: Esta semana el programa analiza grandes éxitos musicales e intenta que el público aprenda inglés, de la mano de unos invitados muy especiales.

programme.title: La ocasión hace al ladrón
programme.desc: En la serie se alternan personajes antiguos como El tio de la Vara, con personajes nuevos como El Cansino historico, con la participación de , Carlos Baute, Angy Fernández y Pitingo.

programme.title: Donde hay patrón no manda marinero
programme.desc: Este programa viene cargado de nuevos sketches. Además de la Vieja'l Visillo, Blashakira, La leyenda de la Vara, Momentos Muertos de la Historia…

programme.title: Cree el ladrón
programme.desc: La leyenda de la Vara sigue su desarrollo con la presentación en sociedad de El tendero, el villano de la historia, interpretado por Santiago Urrialde. Además, La Vieja'l Visillo en Escasez de cotilleo tendrá que sacar rumores de donde no hay.

programme.title: Moscas a cañonazos
programme.desc: En la nueva entrega de 'La leyenda de la Vara', la Argamasa y los hermanos Correa se enfrentan a los macarras del parque y les falla el poder de la "superioridad numérica". 'La Vieja'l Visillo' volverá con nuevos alardes de "comunicación total".

programme.title: Las gallinas que entran por las que salen
programme.desc: La conocida frase de Mota marca el inicio del programa con una nueva entrega de Tu cara me suena, que contará con el futuro presidente de gobierno, Mariano Rajoy (versión Mota).

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los médicos quedan desconcertados cuando un niño de dos años es trasladado urgentemente al hospital con convulsiones cerebrales y dificultades para respirar.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerto al cirujano cardíaco Darryl Sutorius en el sótano de su lujosa casa de Cincinnati, la policía asume que se suicidó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La investigación de un saco de dormir desechado, que contiene zapatillas de deporte ensangrentadas y un bolso, lleva a la policía al cuerpo de una mujer joven.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el año 2000, Judy Southern llegó a casa del trabajo y recibió un disparo de un hombre armado que esperaba dentro. Su esposo llegó poco después, llamó a los servicios de emergencia y la llevó al hospital.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Fue uno de los crímenes más descarados del siglo 20. Adolph Coors III, el ejecutivo de Coors Brewing Company, fue secuestrado y retenido para un rescate.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2000, cuando la adolescente Tara Munsey desapareció al salir de su trabajo en un restaurante de Virginia, no se sabe si se escapó o si fue víctima de un juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un policía retirado es descubierto en su cama, muerto de una sola herida de bala en la cabeza. Su esposa primero dice que el motivo fue un robo; luego le dice a la policía que se suicidó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una atractiva joven fue encontrado a una milla de su auto abandonado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el año 2000, el cuerpo de la bailarina exótica Rachel Siani fue encontrado debajo de un puente de Nueva Jersey. Los investigadores se preguntaron si se había suicidado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una niña de 9 años desaparece, la policía y los voluntarios pasan semanas buscándola.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un cazador de Colorado que había recibido tres disparos fue víctima de un crimen bien planeado. Los investigadores sospecharon dos armas y dos asesinos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El 12 de Mayo de 1994, Crystal Perry fue asesinado viciosamente en su casa en Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, de 32 años, fue encontrado culpable del asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una joven fue encontrada muerta, la policía arrestó rápidamente al sospechoso más probable. Pero la tecnología de punta de la NASA permitió a un odontólogo forense demostrar que el hombre equivocado estaba tras las rejas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: La pista ardiente
programme.desc: Un pirómano en serie anda suelto en Washington, DC. Cada uno de los incendios se inició con el mismo tipo de dispositivo incendiario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los cuerpos de varias mujeres se encuentran en una colina distante en California. La policía hace un descubrimiento cuando una prostituta se escapa y logra identificar a su agresor y su automóvil.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un rico magnate inmobiliario desapareció, pareció ser un juego sucio. En su testamento, dejó instrucciones sobre lo que sucedería si moría en circunstancias violentas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando la policía encuentra el cuerpo de Krista Harrison, de 11 años, hay pocas pistas sobre la identidad del asesino. Pero las autoridades están intrigadas por las inusuales fibras naranjas incrustadas en la ropa que se encuentran cerca de la víctima.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Apenas unas semanas antes de que una testigo testifique contra el hombre acusado de agredirla sexualmente, ella es asesinada en el patio delantero de su propia casa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, cuando un grupo fundamentalista comienza a robar bancos cerca de Spokane, las autoridades saben de inmediato que están tratando con criminales con experiencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las vida cambia después de 20 años de haber transcurrido un crimen sin resolver, y lo mismo ocurre con la medicina forense. Hoy en día, un microscopio de alto poder y el perfil de ADN, revelan una pista que nadie había visto antes.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una pequeña niña se enfermó y murió, los investigadores se vieron sorprendidos. ¿Fue un accidente, una enfermedad inexplicable o un asesinato?

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Durante siete años, un trío de hombres robó un banco tras otro. Siempre se escapaban antes de que llegara la policía y no dejaban pruebas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Inyección de venganza
programme.desc: Una enfermera de 34 años experimenta una variedad de síntomas parecidos a los de la gripe. Ninguno de sus médicos logra descubrir la causa, hasta que visita al ginecólogo para un chequeo de rutina.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En este episodio, un asesinato de una década de una joven ama de casa de Texas es investigado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un millonario y su familia fueron ejecutados en su propio hogar. Durante tres años, los crímenes quedaron sin resolverse. Finalmente, una caja de 30 años de municiones y unas fibras fluorescentes revelan la traición final.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1992, Dawn Bruce, de 22 años, es brutalmente asesinada en su apartamento de Virginia. Los investigadores notan una mancha de sangre en la funda de una almohada que parece haber sido hecha por uno de los dedos del asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Bloqueo del escritor
programme.desc: Una brillante joven arquitecta se enfermó y murió poco antes de testificar en un juicio penal. La autopsia reveló que había sido envenenada con arsénico.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La policía de California tenía varios sospechosos en el robo y brutal asesinato de una pareja de ancianos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los testigos vieron a una mujer en la parte trasera de un camión, agitando los brazos y gritando. Cuando encontraron una chaqueta cerca de un charco de sangre, supieron que lo que habían visto no había sido un paseo divertido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2007, Shamaia Smith desaparece de un club de striptease en East Hartford, Connecticut. La policía considera varios patrones del club, pero se enfocan en un comerciante local, Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los sobrevivientes de las atrocidades nazis reconocieron al arzobispo Trifa, exjefe de la Iglesia Ortodoxa Rumana en los Estados Unidos, por haber dirigido un sangriento ataque contra los judíos durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras la caída de Woodbury, el Gobernador vaga sin rumbo hasta que encuentra a una familia cuyo patriarca está moribundo. El Gobernador se encariña especialmente con Lilly, una niña autista a la que promete proteger siempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador se da cuenta de que el grupo de Martínez es débil, a pesar de que tienen un gran arsenal. Además, localiza a quienes le arrebataron todo lo que tenía.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador captura a Hershel y Michonne y exige al grupo salir de la prisión. Sin embargo, Rick y su gente no van a dejarse vencer sin presentar batalla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Después de la batalla contra el Gobernador, Rick y Carl encuentran una casa en la que Rick intenta reponerse de sus graves heridas y Carl sale en busca de alimentos. Mientras, Michonne trata de encontrarlos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los sobrevivientes del ataque vagan por el bosque, diseminados en grupos pequeños, en busca de cobijo. Tyreese, Lizzie y Mika se topan con una antigua conocida. Mientras, Daryl y Beth buscan a los demás y Glenn despierta en la prisión solo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Carl y Michonne se encuentran con un grupo de hombres extremadamente peligrosos en una casa aparentemente vacía. Mientras, Glenn y Tara conocen a unas personas que viajan hacia Washington D. C.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Beth siguen viajando juntos y Beth le revela que no quiere morir sin haber probado nunca el alcohol. A pesar de que Daryl se muestra contrario a sus intenciones, Beth se emborracha y, de esta forma, ambos se conocen mejor.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras buscan Terminus, Maggie, Sasha y Bob discuten fuertemente y terminan separándose, sin percatarse de que son más vulnerables estando solos. Mientras, Daryl y Beth han encontrado cobijo en una funeraria, pero una horda de zombis los ataca.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tyreese, Carol, Lizzie, Mika y Judith llegan a una cabaña mientras buscan Terminus. Allí, Lizzie enloquece y muestra una fascinación por la muerte que hiela la sangre de Carol y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn y Tara se reencuentran con Maggie, Sasha y Bob en un túnel repleto de zombis mientras se aproximan a Terminus. Entretanto, Daryl se ve obligado a viajar con el mismo grupo de hombres que quiere asesinar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los nuevos amigos de Daryl encuentran a Rick y pretenden violar a Michonne y Carl para después matar a los tres. Mientras, Glenn, Maggie, Sasha, Bob, Tara, Abraham, Eugene y Rosita se dan cuenta de que Terminus no es el paraíso que imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Tyreese llegan a las inmediaciones de Terminus y descubren que sus amigos están retenidos y van a ser sacrificados para ser comidos. Ahora, el destino de todo el grupo depende de ellos dos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick vaga por el bosque y encuentra a Gabriel, un párroco al que salvan de una horda de zombis y les permite pernoctar en su iglesia. Sin embargo, hay algo extraño en él y esa misma noche uno de los integrantes del grupo es secuestrado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gareth y su grupo de caníbales atacan la iglesia mientras Rick y sus compañeros están en el bosque buscándolos para vengar a Bob. Además, el padre Gabriel confiesa el siniestro acto de su pasado que no deja descansar a su conciencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Beth se despierta en un hospital de Atlanta, pero pronto se da cuenta de que los mismos que la auxiliaron y sanaron no la dejarán marchar. No obstante, su nuevo amigo, Noah, y ella tratan de huir del recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras se dirigen hacia el norte, el grupo se ve obligado a detenerse porque una horda de zombis bloquea el camino. La tensión aumenta y la situación termina por estallar cuando Eugene confiesa un secreto que había ocultado a todos hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl persiguen a los captores de Beth por una Atlanta devastada, pero su auto se queda sin gasolina y deben pasar la noche en un refugio para mujeres.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Noah regresan a la iglesia para pedirles ayuda a sus compañeros. Rick y otros integrantes del grupo van a Atlanta con la intención de secuestrar a varios policías para intercambiarlos por Beth y Carol.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: To Live and Die in DC
programme.desc: Lance Hill sticks to the street code of DC and is admired by those who crave fast money, who put risk over reward. It's his turn to tell his story... If he lives.

programme.title: Induced
programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: Back and Forth
programme.desc: Pier and Jade found love though the emotions of skating. Love was built but trust was lost, as deep secrets unfold, back and forth between the UK and USA. Having her heart broken, Jade took her fate in her own hands. It was only a matter of time, that the only plan left was to take revenge.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone’s future.

programme.title: Shuttered Secrets
programme.desc: When Trey’s ex-girlfriend, Jada, unexpectedly shows up to his studio, she accuses him of dark secrets and being involved in a missing persons case. Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

programme.title: Crush
programme.desc: Haunted by her past, a young woman's life is complicated by love, self-discovery, and surrounding violence.

programme.title: Too Much Too Soon
programme.desc: Justin runs an auto body shop, and everything seems on track until he meets Monique, an independent freelance artist. Despite being from two different worlds, they have an instant connection and it feels like the start of something real. When Justin is shot one night, it puts his future, and his connection with Monique to the test. Will love truly be enough to make them last?

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: Thick Trip
programme.desc: Four close-knit friends, all single and yearning for a change, embark on a summer-long 'Queen's Trip' to South Padre, Houston, and the untouched wilderness. As they travel and experience the vibrant cultures and breathtaking landscapes, they confront their fears, rediscover their passions, and explore their own wild sides.

programme.title: The House on Adams Drive
programme.desc: Sean is convinced the only way to keep the woman of his dreams happy is by obtaining as much money as possible. His friend Kordell, who’s an adult film star, helps him with a way to make a lot of money overnight. When they’re sent to a house to possibly film a scene, that turns out to be a real life exorcism.

programme.title: For You I Will
programme.desc: Mikayla is a struggling hopeless romantic. When she meets Jalen, she thinks she’s found the one, but he wants a possession over a partner. He demands her loyalty by asking her for a hit list of all of her ex-boyfriends to secure his love. Will she walk away? Or let her desperation consume her and fall into a deadly trap?

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: An ex-'60s-radical computer hacker (Robert Redford) and his company are tapped for a shady black-box job.","large":"Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: A trucker with a vehicular manslaughter conviction agrees to drive a suspicious shipment for his boss.","large":"An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: A jailed IRA operative (Richard Gere) helps the FBI track a masterful assassin (Bruce Willis) about to perform a political killing.","large":"During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: An FBI renegade (Bruce Willis) tries to stop his nemesis (Alec Baldwin) from killing an autistic boy (Miko Hughes) who cracked a government code.","large":""Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: An ex-cop (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must protect a woman chosen by Satan (Gabriel Byrne) to be the mother of the Antichrist.","large":"With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Blues Brothers 2000
programme.desc: Newly released from prison, Elwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) reassembles the Blues Brothers Band with new members (John Goodman, Joe Morton).","large":"The now-brotherless Ellwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) is finally out of prison, attempting to reunite the old band and find a few new partners in crime (John Goodman), (J. Evan Bonifant). In this sequel to the original "Blues Brothers" comedy/musical, Ellwood battles the Chicago police, sings and dances his way out of numerous sticky situations, and manages to get the old band on the road for a hair-raising adventure.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: An FBI-relocated witness (Mel Gibson) and his ex-girlfriend (Goldie Hawn) from the '60s are chased by the drug thug (David Carradine) he sent to prison.","large":"Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.desc: In this week’s lesson, we explore God's passionate and compassionate nature, emphasizing His emotional depth and love for humanity. The Bible portrays God’s love as far surpassing human love, using parental imagery to highlight His unwavering compassion (Isa. 49:15, Hos. 11:1-9). Despite human unfaithfulness, God’s love is enduring and visceral, as seen in Christ’s compassion during His ministry. programme.desc: Lesson 5 explores the concept of divine wrath as an expression of God's love. God's anger is directed against evil, injustice, and oppression, not out of arbitrary malice but in defense of His creation. Divine wrath is a loving response to the harm caused by sin, which hurts those God loves. Though God is slow to anger and abundant in compassion, His wrath is ultimately a righteous reaction to evil. Jesus also displayed righteous indignation, highlighting God's deep concern for justice. Christ’s atonement reconciles divine justice with mercy, offering salvation to believers from God's righteous judgment.

programme.title: La Ciencia de la Verdadera Educación
programme.sub-title: El desarrollo máximo de las facultades – Isaías Rojas
programme.desc: Esta presentación hace parte de nuestro simposio sobre la verdadera educación: La Ciencia de la Verdadera Educación. ¿Por qué un simposio sobre la verdadera educación?﻿ La educación no es solamente para los niños y jóvenes, sino que hemos de ser estudiantes por toda la eternidad. programme.title: FantomWorks: Unique en son genre
programme.desc: Mike adore les Hudson et il n’est pas peu fier de son cabriolet coupé Hudson 112 1939 qui appartenait à son père, surtout qu’il ne reste plus que cet exemplaire sur les trois étant l’usine de fabrication.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Throwing Heat

programme.title: FantomWorks: Damaged Goods
programme.desc: Bo ignore que sa Corvette 1970 nécessite des tonnes de travaux, notamment sur sa carrosserie, abîmée par des vandales. Dan ramène à la vie la GTO 1964 de Steve que sa compagnie d’assurances a déclarée perte totale.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jerry laisse à FantomWorks un coupé d'affaire Plymouth 1939 en pièces détachées dans l'espoir que Dan en fera une voiture digne de ce nom. Bill demande à Dan de lui trouver une Gran Sport 1972 et l'équiper d'accessoires rares et fonctionnels.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Thunder Time
programme.desc: Dan installe un moteur GTO dans la Thunderbird 1956 de Ian pour en faire une voiture sport. Le doc Pellerin a remporté plusieurs prix grâce à sa Volvo PV 1937 avant que sa carrosserie ne s'endommage. Dan la restaurera pour lui.

programme.title: FantomWorks: High Impact
programme.desc: George est convaincu que sa Mustang Mach 1971 nécessite peu de travaux. Il ignore que des cascadeurs l’ont utilisée. L'équipe de FantomWorks devra littéralement recoller les pièces de la Mercury Woody 1952 de Mick.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Road to SEMA
programme.desc: Quand Donnie dit à Dan qu'il veut restaurer puis exposer sa Fastback 1968 au salon du SEMA, Dan est déstabilisé, car il comptait lui-même y présenter sa Corvette 1964 et que les délais sont extrêmement serrés.

programme.title: FantomWorks: 85 in the Fast Lane
programme.desc: Nous passons la journée à l'atelier FantomWorks où Dan ne compte pas les heures pour restaurer une moto ancienne, une Valiant 1963, une Grand National 1987 et la GTO 1970 d'un vétéran qui rentre au pays sous peu.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Because I Can
programme.desc: Même si Dan trouve la Chevelle 1970 de Mickey impeccable, ce dernier souhaite y apporter plusieurs modifications. Quant à la Studebaker 1963 de Thom, elle fuit de partout, ses systèmes sont défaillants et son plancher rouillé tient avec de la colle.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Nightmare on Hampton Blvd
programme.desc: Rick compte faire installer une série de gadgets étranges, dont deux lance-flammes, sur son corbillard Cadillac 1972. Merlyn et Lynn possèdent une camionnette Chevrolet Apache 1959 si dangereuse qu'ils n'ont jamais osé la sortie de leur allée.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: La restauration d’une Fleetwood 1953 donne des cauchemars à Dan, car elle n’a pas été conçue pour recevoir l'équipement que son proprio, Don, souhaite y faire installer. John souhaite que sa précieuse Mercury Cougar 1967 puisse rugir plus fort qu'avant.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Tough Act to Follow

programme.title: FantomWorks: If It Sprays, It Stays

programme.title: FantomWorks: All Revved Up

programme.title: FantomWorks: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: Dan retape une Coccinelle décapotable qui a déjà fait l'objet de deux restaurations et dont la peinture est affreuse. L'équipe de FantomWorks a tout un lot de problèmes en restaurant une Maserati.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: 34 nyankomne og veteraner møder op i dragten for at tage gruppebilledet. Men der sættes en dæmper på glædes dag, fordi Dallas Cowboy Cheerleaders direktør og koreograf endnu ikke har offentliggjort truppen 2010.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Prøverne begynder
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington, Texas huser igen optagelsesprøverne til Dallas Cowboys' cheerleadere. 500 kandidater, der drømmer om at komme på DCC-holdet i 2011-12, ankommer før solopgang til de første prøver.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Det flotte Cowboys Stadium er stedet for DCC's sidste prøver. Spændingen er stor for de 69 nye piger, da de 18 DCC-veteraner slutter sig til kampen om de eftertragtede invitationer til træningslejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Træningslejren
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften på Valley Ranch! Presset på de nye kandidater er tydeligt, mens de prøver at planlægge og skaffe sig nye boliger i Dallas.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Den berømte uniform
programme.desc: Der er gået to uger af træningslejren, og Kelli og Judy begynder at vælge de første fra. Ugens øvetimer er vigtige for alle pigerne, da de forventes at mestre den verdensberømte DCC-kickline og at gå i spagat.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens tredje uge, og de nye hentes ind til deres DCC-makeovers. De får et nyt look med frisure og makeup og forvandles i DCC-støbeformen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: PR-fotos
programme.desc: Aftenens prøver starter med et brag, da DCC's Technical Director Kitty Carter aflægger et uventet besøg på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders er to uger fra den første kamp og DCC's leder Kelli McGonagill Finglass og DCC-koreografen Judy Trammel har travlt med at udskille de sidste og sætte holdet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finalen
programme.desc: Alt afhænger af træningslejrens sidste aften. I aften opfyldes eller knuses drømme. Kelli udfordrer pigerne ved at tage dem med på Cowboys' træningsbane for at se dem optræde.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: De indledende prøver
programme.desc: I denne to timers sæsonpremiere på Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team. 600 kandidater ankommer til Cowboys Stadium til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders indledende prøver.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Træningslejren
programme.desc: Træningslejren begynder, og mange af de nye kandidater er flyttet til Dallas uden nogen garanti for at klare træningslejren og blive en Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Spagat
programme.desc: Det er kun anden uge, og Kelli og Judy er hurtige til at introducere kandidaterne for holdets særkender. Mange af de nye er aldrig gået i spagat, og deres manglende erfaring fører til skader for nogle piger.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens fjerde uge, og de nye hentes ind til deres DCC-makeovers. Under Kelli Finglass' vågne øje giver nye frisurer og makeup pigerne deres DCC-look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Uge fem
programme.desc: Det er uge fem af træningslejren, og Kelli er syg. DCC's Technical Director Kitty Carter afløser og afholder ugens første træning. Kitty lægger ikke fingrene imellem, da hun konfronterer adskillige piger med deres sjuskede danse.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Sidste frasortering
programme.desc: Træningslejrens uge syv starter med prøver på banen på Cowboys Stadium. Kelli og Judy er klar til at frasortere de sidste, og aftenens prøver kan afgøre, hvem der kommer på holdet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I den sidste runde er konkurrencen benhård. Nu skal dem, der er gået videre, dyste mod erfarne veteraner for en af de eftertragtede pladser i DCC's træningslejr.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Træningslejren begynder! De nye kandidater er spændte, og fulde af beundring, da de møder veteranerne for første gang på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Der er kun gået to uger af træningslejren, da det er tid til at begynde at sende folk hjem. Uniformsprøven er det første punkt på dagsordenen. Det er bittersødt for de nye, for de har endnu ikke gjort sig fortjent til dragten.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Efter at have taget afsked med en af deres egne, må træningslejrkandidaterne se sandheden i øjnene - ingen plads i truppen er sikker. Hårdføre Kitty Carter bliver bedt om at arbejde med de svage kandidater og få dem i form.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Hele gruppen trænger til at blive rusket og gæstekoreografen Kitty Carter står til tjeneste. Truppen må gennemlide en benhård dansetime og nogle af pigerne bryder totalt sammen. Så er det tid til en lektie i DCC's etikette.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Nogle drømme går i opfyldelse, når de heldige træningslejr-kandidater står model i den ikoniske Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-dragt under en sexet fotooptagelse.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Flere skal sorteres fra, og der er kun to undervisningstimer tilbage, men pigerne kæmper for at få deres berømte cowboystøvler på for første gang. Så skal Judy og Megan Fox give kritik ved den sidste dans.
